dogecoin.text:
Recency Bias:  

People tend to focus on recent success stories (e.g., early Dogecoin investors becoming millionaires) while ignoring the countless failures. https://t.co/mDNlU642Bd

Bitcoin isn’t just a currency; it’s a manifesto. A middle finger to the traditional system.  
NFTs turned digital art into a cultural reset, making us question what "value" really means.  
And let’s not forget the memes. Dogecoin started as a joke and became a global sensation
Dogecoin will always be the meme king. Litecoin’s just trying to crash the party with a "I was here first" energy. Sorry, Charlie, but you can’t just retroactively meme your way into history.
